sources.locator: "War in Darfur", revision 1375318567, § Origins of the conflict

explanation: The English article gives several explanations for the origins of the conflict that started in 2003: land disputes between semi-nomadic herders and sedentary farmers, access to water, and the two rebel groups fighting the Khartoum government. Among them, the article says the Darfur crisis is also related to the First and Second Sudanese civil wars between the Arab-dominated government and the Christian and animist black southerners. The article relates these explanations without ranking them. This link is one of several the page offers, written at the strength the page gives it.
